findings.summary: Import normalizes the wrong lifts — inverted condition skips normalization for legacy lifts that need it.
findings.mechanism: The task requires deriving a default method for legacy lifts that predate the method system (i.e. lifts with no `method`). `normalizeLift` (src/domain/methods/normalize.ts:15-18) does exactly that: if `lift.method` is falsy it fills in a default `linear` method; if truthy it just re-parses it. But the import code writes `lift.method ? normalizeLift(lift) : lift`, which only calls `normalizeLift` when `method` is already present, and passes legacy lifts (no `method`) straight through untouched. Importing a version-1 backup (or any legacy lift) therefore leaves `lift.method` undefined in the database, defeating the stated purpose of the change and reintroducing the inconsistent shape it was meant to fix.
